args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update parseAmount to strip generic currency symbols/characters or non-numeric prefixes/suffixes such as the rupee sign (₹) or currency codes (like CHF) so that amounts formatted with currency symbols are correctly parsed into minor units.
args.title: Support currency symbols and codes like rupee sign and CHF in parseAmount
